subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

400900101.text: Hey, you guys finally made it!

400900102.text: I was searching for hours. Still didn't see any sign of those three, so I decided to come back.

400900104.text: Uh, it's kinda hard to explain...

400900105.text: We never managed to find those three, either.

400900106.text: I see... So you came up empty-handed, too.

400900107.text: Well, it doesn't matter! I already came up with a new plan!

400900109.text: Shinobu told me a saying after she got back from studying in Liyue. It went something like... "The something by day becomes..." Uhh, something by night?

400900110.text: "The hunter by day becomes the hunted by night."

400900111.text: Yeah, that's what I said! C'mon, keep up!

400900112.text: Anyway, I was so focused on scaring people last round that those three dressed up as ghosts caught me completely off guard.

400900113.text: But not this time! Oh no! I'll be hiding nearby and waiting for those three to emerge first, then I'll nail 'em with a surprise attack.

400900114.text: You two just gotta keep playing it natural and join the contest. Got it? Okay, see ya later!

400900115.text: Wait, Itto! Ugh, he ran off again!

400900116.text: Well, his plan does make some sense at least... Let's go talk to the shrine maiden so we can join the second round.

400900201.text: Mwahahaha... Congratulations on winning the first round of the Test of Courage.

400900202.text: Now you're one step closer to the dark, messy truth. But is that really a good thing?

400900203.text: Hey, cut the nonsense! What we just saw was super terrifying!

400900205.text: Hearing the words "super terrifying" is exactly what all us event organizers would like to hear.

400900206.text: Ugh no, that's not what Paimon means! Something mysterious is also happening here, not just the event!

400900207.text: So what? You've heard the stories about the Test of Courage, haven't you?

400900208.text: Everyone who participates in the event faces a variety of emotions.

400900209.text: People are afraid of seeing their innermost fears appear before them, yet they still seek the thrill of experiencing those fears.

400900210.text: So isn't it natural for us to have things in the dark and deathly silent forest to help fulfill that experience?

400900211.text: Just like the grinning monster standing behind you right now, waiting for you to turn around...

400900215.text: Hehehe... I knew a little trick like that wouldn't be enough to scare you off.

400900216.text: So, congrats on passing this test. The second round of the Test of Courage will begin shortly.

400900217.text: Have you found your partner yet?

400900218.text: Huh? But don't we already have a partner from the last round...?

400900219.text: Yes, your team's outstanding effort certainly won you the last round.

400900220.text: So it's understandable that you'd want to pair up with your previous partner... But unfortunately, you must find a different partner for each round of the event.

400900221.text: If you don't have a partner by the time the next round begins, then...

400900222.text: Yeah, yeah, Paimon already knows! If we don't have a partner in time, then we'll be disqualified!

400900223.text: Let's ask around and see if there's anyone looking for a partner!

subQuests.subQuestName: Pick a partner out of the three contestants

400902001.text: Don't freak out, boys! Whatever happens, I'll protect you!

subQuests.subQuestName: Begin the second round of the Test of Courage

400900901.text: You appear to have found a partner. Let's see if you can repeat your luck from the first round.

400900902.text: Though, whether winning should be considered "good luck" or not is debatable, hehehe...

400900903.text: Anyway, I will now reveal the item you'll be searching for in the second round of the Test of Courage.

400900905.text: A fan? You mean like the thing we use to keep cool when it's hot out?

400900906.text: Correct. The fan was personally selected by the Yashiro Commissioner himself, and has been placed somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

400900907.text: There will be signs to guide the way, but beware, the darkness that lurks in the forest is drawing nearer.

400900908.text: Mwahahahaha... Remember, if you can't go on any further, you can always give up and live to see another day.

400900909.text: We'll never give up! Let's go!

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the second round of the Test of Courage

400903101.text: Hehe! Look what we have here! Isn't this the fan we're looking for?

400903102.text: Wow, it has such a beautiful design on it. Are those fireworks? It seems to be for some sort of festival!

400903103.text: So now that we've found this fan, does that mean we've won the second round of the Test of Courage? Let's bring it back!

400903105.text: Hmm, wonder if Itto's still out trying to capture those three from earlier. Paimon's a little worried about him... Why don't we have a look around?

400903106.text: Hmm? Is there something else you need to take care of? How about I take the fan back, then?

400903108.text: No need to thank me. It's been a blast doing the Test of Courage with you guys! I'd love to do it again!

400901301.text: So you must be Hitotsume Kozou!

400901303.text: Hehe, no need to be nervous. I'm Yoimiya, and I run Naganohara Fireworks.

400901304.text: Oh...! I once saw some Naganohara fireworks... Even though I was watching from a distance, they were still so beautiful, bursting across the sky...

400901305.text: Really? Then the next time we meet, I'll bring some fireworks for us to launch together! It'll be fun!

400901306.text: Wow, really? Thank you very much... And, if I may ask, are you Lord Kaedehara Kazuha?

400901307.text: Yes, that's me, but I'm afraid that I'm no lord... just a wandering samurai.

400901308.text: I've seen you with your sword in the wilderness... You made quick work of many opponents with your amazing swordsmanship.

400901309.text: Ah, that must have been when I was trying to escape Inazuma... It wasn't as impressive as you make it seem. I had to face many trying situations before I was able to leave the islands.

400901310.text: The head of the Kamisato Clan also lent me his assistance at the time. By the way, this is his sister.

400901311.text: Oh, so y—you must be the one and only Shirasagi Himegimi? What an honor...

400901312.text: There's no need to be so formal...

400901313.text: I never imagined I'd ever meet someone as distinguished as you! I must be dreaming...!

400901314.text: Hey, don't you want to go talk to them, too?

400901315.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm rather shy...

400901316.text: Really? That's strange, you seemed completely fine when we were chatting.

400901317.text: I'm not sure why, but I feel so relaxed when talking with you, General Gorou.

400901318.text: Actually, I'm the most timid of the three of us. I hid for days the last time someone tossed a stone into the river...

400901319.text: Ah! Sorry for rambling on. It's odd... I'm not normally like this...

400901320.text: It's okay. You can't excel at everything. The important thing is to have the courage to change.

400901321.text: Hey there, chatting away I see... Mind if I join you?

400901322.text: I've never seen a Kappa before.

400901324.text: Thank you for bringing so many amazing people to meet us, Itto.

400901325.text: Hahaha! It's nothing! Being the "The One and Oni" means being the best, you know.

400901326.text: Oh — I should mention that, uh, I even have my own gang, and every member has a special title!

400901327.text: Classic Itto... There you go, bragging about yourself... again!

400901328.text: Don't confuse them! Everyone's here for the Test of Courage, not because you brought them here! Half the people here don't even know who you are!

400901329.text: Hey! This is my moment, Paimon! Don't ruin it for me!

400901330.text: Hehe, Itto really isn't as cool as he claims to be.

400901331.text: #When it comes to having connections in Inazuma, nobody can beat Paimon and {NICKNAME}!

400901332.text: Oh yeah!? Alright, well then let's have a little contest and see who knows the most people!

400901333.text: Sure! Bring it on, Bull-Chucker Beetle Boy!

400901334.text: Ahem... please don't fight. Actually, I think you're both really amazing.

400901335.text: And you also have a great friendship. Just like Lord Kamai and the samurai...

400901339.text: Darn it! I was so caught up with the youkai that I forgot I was supposed to scare the daylights outta the gang!

400901341.text: Ahem... hey fellas, look, I can explain, I—

400901344.text: We shouldn't have ever doubted you, Boss. You were right!

400901345.text: Yeah, the Test of Courage is terrifying! Th—There are definitely ghosts here!!!

400901346.text: I still get shivers just thinking about it... But the thrill was kinda fun...

400901347.text: Oh... uh... hahaha well, I told you it would be an exhilarating experience, but noooo, none of you believed me.

400901348.text: Anyway, no need to be too scared now. Let me tell you what's happening here...

400901349.text: It turns out, there aren't any ghosts here, all the scary stuff you saw was just a little misunderstanding we had with the youkai.

400901351.text: Ah... Sorry, but I've never seen these three before.

400901352.text: I'm not sure where you've been or what you've seen, but I don't think it had anything to do with us...

400901356.text: H—Hold on, little Youko... You're kidding, right? You know, now's really not the time for that!

400901357.text: N—No, I'm serious. I really don't know what's going on...

400901358.text: But if it wasn't you guys... does that mean there are real ghosts out here!?

400901359.text: Wait a minute, we did meet some lady who was all dressed up...

400901360.text: Ah, that's right! Paimon assumed she was a youkai too, and we even played Akitsu Yuugei with her.

400901362.text: *gulp* I—I'm not sure who it was you met...

400901363.text: But we're the only three youkai who wanted to hold a festival here...

400901364.text: Ah! So she was a ghost?

400901366.text: Calm down! Everyone j—just calm down now!

400901368.text: Hmm? Oh, you're the Tenryou Commission's...

400901370.text: There's nothing to fear. Even if there really is a ghost, all your noise would drive it away.

400901371.text: Itto, you and your gang should go and inform the other contestants about the situation.

400901374.text: Phew... Paimon somehow feels a little better now that Heizou's here...

400901401.text: Could the rumors be true then? Do strange phenomena really happen every time the Test of Courage is held...?

400901501.text: Unease pervades the air, and fear is spreading.

400901502.text: Maybe this is the real Test of Courage...? It's already becoming an unforgettable experience for me.

400901601.text: "Recite this to yourself, keep your mind clear and at peace. Free your thoughts from spirits and ghosts"...

400901602.text: Those were Her Excellency's remarks in the directive. She once said, "There is nothing to be afraid of as long as your conscience is clear."

400901603.text: If only Her Excellency were here. She would get to the bottom of all this in no time.

400901701.text: So is there really a ghost around here?

400901702.text: I'm gonna go look for it. I've never seen a ghost before! Oh, how exciting!

400901801.text: I believe my lord had foreseen this situation...

400901802.text: He has my absolute trust, but given Lady Ayaka is still here, we must get to the bottom of this as soon as possible.

400901901.text: Shh... this is one of my usual hiding spots. It's always safe here.

400901902.text: Let me show you a trick. Just cover your eyes, and the scary things will go away...

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the second round of the Test of Courage

400903201.text: Phew... this place should be safe.

400903202.text: I can't believe I made it this far. Hey, did I get any taller?

400903207.text: Enough about that. Look! Isn't this the fan we're looking for?

400903208.text: It has fireworks printed on it, so it must be for some kind of festival!

400903209.text: So does that mean the second round of the Test of Courage is over now?

400903210.text: Yep, seems like it. Haha, we've won again!

400903211.text: Great. *yawn* Because I was just starting... to feel sleepy...

400903212.text: Hmm, wonder if Itto's still out trying to capture those three from earlier. Paimon's a little worried about him... Why don't we have a look around?

400903213.text: In that case, I'll take the fan back with me and have a little nap. Just don't stay out here too long...

subQuests.subQuestName: Complete the second round of the Test of Courage

400903301.text: Ah, this must be the fan we're looking for.

400903302.text: Seems we're the first to find it, too. Our luck's not so bad after all.

400903303.text: Let Paimon see... Oh, it has fireworks printed on it, so it must be for some sort of festival!

400903304.text: Huh... Paimon thought Ayato would choose a folding fan... You know, like the kind Ayaka usually uses.

400903305.text: You're right, this fan doesn't appear to be something my lord would usually use...

400903306.text: Anyway, let's head back now that we've found it.

400903307.text: Hmm, wonder if Itto's still out trying to capture those three from earlier. Paimon's a little worried about him... Why don't we have a look around?

400903308.text: Hmm? Are you planning to stay here? Then allow me to take the fan back.

400903309.text: But remember, you're only one round away from taking home the special prize! Make sure you get yourselves ready and give it your best shot.

400901001.text: Wow Itto, you really captured them!

400901002.text: Seriously, why didn't you run when I told you?

400901003.text: What're you saying... We couldn't abandon you!

400901004.text: Yeah, that's right! So just get on with it... If you're gonna eat us, then you'll have to deal with all three of us!

400901005.text: We won't back down, even if... even if we're already in your stomach!

400901006.text: Who said we were going to eat you? Wait, are you the ghosts of something tasty?

400901007.text: And Itto, why're you so quiet all of a sudden?

400901008.text: Hmm... I have a weird feeling that I've seen these three somewhere before...

400901009.text: Ah, I know! These are all creatures from the Ultimate Youkai Field Guide that granny used to show me!

400901010.text: There's Youko, Kappa, and Hitotsume Kozou! They're all youkai.

400901011.text: It sure took you long enough to notice.

400901012.text: Well, we recognized you right away! You're an oni, aren't you?

400901013.text: According to legends, oni are grouchy, extremely strong, and crush other youkai into balls to eat them up!

400901014.text: Pfff! That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard! Who came up with that!?

400901015.text: Besides, you're the ones people are scared of! Hiding behind bushes and scaring people off the road, what are you trying to do here?

400901016.text: #Don't think I didn't see you! ...Following {M#him}{F#her} around and conjuring up all sorts of weird, scary stuff.

400901017.text: Aha, so it was you three!

400901018.text: No, we weren't trying to scare anyone. We were just trying to, uh...

400901024.text: Even though you scared the daylights out of Paimon a few times, it doesn't seem like you were doing it on purpose.

400901025.text: Anyway, let's hear your side of the story and Paimon will decide whether or not to forgive you!

400901026.text: Ahem, well, the truth is... we were planning a festival.

400901027.text: One hosted by the youkai, but humans are also welcome to attend.

400901028.text: You mean, the Mikawa Flower Festival?

400901029.text: Ah, the festival that Ei mentioned!

400901030.text: Mikawa Flower Festival... huh, that does ring a bell.

400901031.text: Ah right, it used to be hosted by the top youkai. I heard it was supposed to be a lot of fun... I mean, not as fun as my Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, but still...

400901032.text: Yes, the Mikawa Flower Festival is our aspiration... But we know that our festival doesn't deserve that name.

400901033.text: The times of Hyakkiyakou are long gone, we're just a bunch of little youkai living in the wilderness.

400901034.text: As you can see, we lack the necessary youkai powers to put on such a grand festival.

400901035.text: But... we're determined to still reach out to humans and express our gratitude.

400901036.text: Huh? Gratitude? What do you mean?

400901037.text: Mm-hmm. You see, we live in the wilderness and are frequently attacked by monsters.

400901038.text: They would come and stir up trouble on our land, forcing us to hand over our food... Sometimes they would even get rough and leave us injured.

400901039.text: But later, many human adventurers came into the wilderness and drove off the monsters, allowing us to live in peace.

400901040.text: Ah, I get it now. You wanna repay the favor, but your powers are too puny!

400901041.text: Hey, don't let it get to ya. You might be a bunch of pip-squeaks, but you're all solid youkai in my book!

400901042.text: So are you the ones who set up the Akitsu Yuugei game on the beach?

400901043.text: Yep, that was us! Have you tried it yet? Isn't it fun?

400901044.text: We drew inspiration from the legendary Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura. It took a lot of youkai power to set it up.

400901045.text: After that, we didn't have much youkai power left, so we set up some stalls in the forest to add to the festival atmosphere...

400901046.text: We were just following you to see your reactions.

400901047.text: Is the Akitsu Yuugei really that important? Why did you spend all of your youkai power to build it?

400901048.text: #Paimon would have taken {NICKNAME} for a big meal if you had set up more food stalls!

400901050.text: To be honest, we've never met a human before, so we had no idea what you would like...

400901051.text: We focused on building the Akitsu Yuugei because of a legend we heard.

400901053.text: It's the story of youkai meeting a human during a festival hundreds of years ago.

400901054.text: The Mikawa Flower Festival is meant to bring happiness to all who attend, and Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura is a symbol of friendship.

400901055.text: That's why, when we decided to hold the festival here, setting up Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura was our first priority.

400901056.text: Unfortunately, the real Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura has been lost to time. What we created is a version of the game we heard about from a wandering merchant, so we changed the name to Akitsu Yuugei.

400901057.text: We heard that someone had been trapped in Akitsu Yuugei.

400901059.text: We have no idea what could have gone wrong!

400901060.text: We closed Akitsu Yuugei a while ago and carefully checked it for any issues.

400901061.text: But, we didn't find anything wrong with it... Maybe it was just some strange mishap caused by our unstable youkai power at the time.

400901062.text: Hmm, they don't look like they're lying, and believe me, I know a liar when I see one! Maybe it really was just an accident.

400901063.text: After that incident, people stopped coming to the attraction.

400901064.text: Later, a human man with blue hair appeared and walked around the area...

400901065.text: He had a piercing gaze, I almost felt like he could see us.

400901066.text: But then he turned and quickly left without saying anything.

400901067.text: It wasn't long before large numbers of people began coming to the Chinju Forest!

400901068.text: And visitors were playing Akitsu Yuugei again. It was wonderful.

400901071.text: Now that you mention it, the fan that Ayato chose is the same kind that's used at a festival... Do you think that he knew about the youkai when he decided to hold the Test of Courage here?

400901072.text: Oh, so my bro Ayato is here for the Test of Courage, too?

400901073.text: Or maybe he's here to catch Onikabuto... Ha, had I known that, I would have brought the one I caught a few days ago to battle him!

400901074.text: Wow, Itto's still clueless about who Ayato really is...

400901075.text: It's alright, no need to tell him for now.

400901076.text: Well anyway, seems like all the strange things we saw earlier were caused by these little youkai, not ghosts. What a relief...

400901077.text: And now that we know what was happening, the Test of Courage doesn't seem that scary after all!

400901078.text: Hey, you want to hang out with humans, right? I totally get that.

400901079.text: After all, we youkai are becoming a rare breed these days. If all we do is isolate, we'll only feel more lonely. So, why don't you let this oni do ya a favor, hmm?

400901080.text: See, I'm a youkai too, right, and I'm already a natural in human society. I bet there's not a single person in Inazuma who hasn't heard of Arataki "The One and Oni" Itto!

400901081.text: Hahaha! C'mon, let's go! I'll show you around!

400901082.text: Now that Paimon doesn't feel so scared anymore, maybe we can walk around the area?

400901083.text: The youkai said they wanted to host a festival, but Paimon was too busy having the bejeebers scared out of her to pay any attention until now.

400901084.text: Come to think of it, Paimon remembers seeing some festival-related items on the beach... Let's head over there and take a look. Maybe we can help out!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the site of Akitsu Yuugei

400900501.text: Hey there! Congrats on winning the first round of the Test of Courage.

400900502.text: Thoma! Wait, were you also a contestant in the first round?

400900503.text: I sure was! But I couldn't shake this constant feeling that someone was secretly following me the entire round.

400900504.text: He didn't seem to be from the Yashiro Commission, and I was concerned that he might be out to stir up trouble at the event, so I tried to capture him.

400900505.text: I didn't expect him to run so fast. I gave chase for a while, but I couldn't keep up... and before I knew it, the round was over.

400900506.text: Hmm, is there a chance he wasn't there to cause trouble? Maybe he was just trying to scare people.

400900507.text: Coming all the way to the Test of Courage to scare people? Well, I guess the world is full of all kinds of weirdos...

400900508.text: Anyway, I'm gonna be sure to show everyone my abilities in the second round.

400900509.text: Oh, Paimon remembers you once mentioned that you like kaidan...

400900510.text: Yeah, that's right. Once I really get into it, you might find me to be your toughest competitor.

400900511.text: Haha, I'm only kidding, of course. I'm not here for the prizes, just to have fun.

400900512.text: My lord has granted me a rare vacation, so I'd rather spend my time relaxing than worrying about some contest.

400900513.text: Speaking of which, have you found a partner yet? Would you like to pair up with me?

400900516.text: I can't guarantee we'll be able to win the second round, but I'll do my best to help. Let's give it our best shot!

400900518.text: Ah, I understand. Hope you can find the right partner and win the second round.

400900519.text: You've probably already heard that to win the Grand Narukami Shrine's special prize. You have to win all three rounds.

400900520.text: I'd like to know what the prize is as well... And you're the only one who has that chance now, so go for it!

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the site of Akitsu Yuugei

400901101.text: Wait! You're the strange lady we met before!

400901103.text: I have to say, I'm impressed by your willingness to approach me after last time. You're much braver than I thought.

400901104.text: But I'm not going to let you off the hook so easily this time. If you don't leave, I'll—

400901105.text: Hmph! Nice try, but you don't scare us anymore!

400901106.text: We just met your fellow youkai, and they told us everything!

400901108.text: That's right! You're another little youkai who lives in the wilderness, aren't you? We just met Youko, Kappa, and Hitotsume Kozou!

400901109.text: So which type of youkai are you? Let Paimon guess... uh... hmm, actually Paimon has no idea what you are!

400901110.text: Anyway, it doesn't matter. We're on our way to play Akitsu Yuugei, care to join us?

400901112.text: How could this be happening now? All I needed was a little more time, and I could...!

400901113.text: Huh? What's the matter? Are you not feeling well?

400901114.text: Oh! Maybe you're hungry? Or maybe you didn't sleep well? You look pretty exhausted.

400901115.text: Don't worry. Itto has already taken your fellow youkai to meet some new friends! Everyone will get along just fine.

400901118.text: Yeah, so there's no need to worry. C'mon, let's go play Akitsu Yuugei!

400901119.text: We'll see who can finish the game the quickest. The loser will have to grant the winner a wish!

400900701.text: Oh, will you pair up with me for the Test of Courage?

400900703.text: Really? You're willing to be my partner?

400900704.text: Great... But please keep an eye on me, and don't let me fall asleep again.

400900705.text: It's pretty scary here, but I'm going to face my fears this time.

400900707.text: Okay... If you want me to be your partner, you can find me here.

400901201.text: Amazing! You cleared all the elemental cubes so quickly.

400901202.text: Hehe, Paimon thinks we got this in the bag! Alright, it's your turn.

400901204.text: You watch as the lady finishes the game in record speed.

400901205.text: #No way, she hit every cube in one shot and finished even faster than you, {NICKNAME}!

400901206.text: Uh, Paimon's head is spinning after watching that! Did you see how she did it?

400901209.text: Even if the rules have changed a little, I would never lose to amateurs like you.

400901210.text: Oh right, you're a youkai... You're the ones who created Akitsu Yuugei.

400901211.text: No wonder you were so good... Anyway, we'll keep our word; you can make a wish now.

400901212.text: But before you say anything, we won't do anything that's clearly impossible or harmful to others.

400901213.text: A wish, huh? Then I wish...

400901215.text: Wait, what? But didn't we just have a great time together?

400901217.text: Don't ever come near me or speak to me again.

400901218.text: Surely that's a wish you can fulfill, right?

400901219.text: This is my final word of warning. If I ever see your faces again, I will, uh... I'll steal your souls!

400901220.text: Scared now? Good, then don't come here again!

400901221.text: Uhh, Paimon doesn't get it... Did we do something wrong?

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to the site of the Test of Courage

400902101.text: Uhh, hellooo? Miss shrine maiden...? Strange, she isn't here.

400902102.text: Waaaah! What's this? Look, there's something written in red on the bulletin board!

400902104.text: Does this mean that the item we have to find in the third round is a hagoita?

400902105.text: The shrine maiden appears to be urging us to finish the third round of the Test of Courage.

400902107.text: *gasp* Has she been taken away by a ghost!?

400902108.text: Will Paimon be next!? *gulp* Oh, Paimon won't ever leave your side now!

400902109.text: The words are scribbled hastily, but there's no evidence of a struggle. However... aren't there too many words written here?

400902111.text: I believe that the three items chosen for this three-round contest were each selected by the three organizing parties.

400902112.text: The Dango Milk was chosen by the merchant who funded the event, and the fan was chosen by the Yashiro Commission, which provided the staff.

400902113.text: So, does the hagoita, which should have been chosen by the Grand Narukami Shrine, have any unique significance?

400902114.text: Let's worry about that later. The bigger question is, are we really going to join the third round of the Test of Courage?

400902115.text: Paimon would love to win the grand prize, but our safety comes first!

400902116.text: How about we... make a tactical retreat!

400902117.text: I still have my commission to complete, so I'll stay.

400902118.text: Fear arises from mystery, and it's a detective's job to unearth the truth from the mystery.

400902119.text: Huh, Paimon somehow feels a little better after hearing you say that...

400902120.text: Okay then, let's wait for a while.

400902121.text: Maybe the shrine maiden had something to take care of and will be back soon...

400892001.text: Have you found a partner yet?

400900301.text: #Heya {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I had a feeling you two would be here!

400900303.text: Mm-hmm. I was also here for the first round, but I arrived a little early, so maybe that's why I didn't see you.

400900304.text: By the way, I heard you were the winners. Impressive! I eventually found the hidden Dango Milk too, but it was already too late.

400900305.text: Hehe... Actually, Paimon still doesn't know how we managed to find it.

400900306.text: #Paimon was just hiding behind {M#him}{F#her} the whole time, and somehow we won!

400900307.text: #{NICKNAME}, you never told me you were so good at this sort of event... You weren't keeping it a secret, were you?

400900308.text: Anyway, would ya like to pair up with me? We'd be an amazing team! With us working together, the second round will be a piece of cake.

400900310.text: Hehe, awesome! Don't worry, you'll see that being on my team is a blast!

400900311.text: Now let's get out there and win this thing... We'll move faster than a firework shooting straight into the sky! It'll be like WHOOOSHHH and the round will be ours!

400900313.text: Oh, I understand. You have to put some thought into choosing the best partner... You did already win the first round, after all.

400900314.text: But I'm definitely no pushover when it comes to the Test of Courage. I've been to loads of these events.

400900315.text: Besides, choosing me means you'll have one less tough competitor to deal with, hehe! Anyway, give it some thought.

400900402.text: Hey, Sayu! Are you here for the Test of Courage, too?

400900404.text: She looks like she just woke up... No wait, she's actually trying to fall asleep!

400900405.text: The Test of Courage is too scary, so I keep my eyes closed to not feel scared.

400900406.text: But as soon as I close my eyes, it's really easy to fall asleep...

400900407.text: During the first round, a big bull-headed beast leaped out of nowhere and scared me half to death, so I ran and hid behind a tree.

400900408.text: I closed my eyes and tried to hide for a while, but it was really dark and I fell asleep... By the time I woke up, the round was already over.

400900409.text: A big bull-headed beast... Wait, that sounds like Ushi!

400900410.text: Now, no one wants to partner up with me for the second round.

400900411.text: Oh, poor Sayu... Wait, but why would you join the Test of Courage in the first place?

400900412.text: Oh, because I heard that being frightened causes you to grow taller...

400900413.text: What kind of silly idea is that!? That's just a load of baloney!

400900414.text: I wasn't sure if it was true, either, but since I heard it could help people grow taller, I decided to give it a shot...

400900415.text: Well, Sayu doesn't have a partner yet. Should we team up with her?

400900417.text: Really? You're willing to be my partner?

400900418.text: Great... But please keep an eye on me, and don't let me fall asleep again.

400900419.text: It's pretty scary here, but I'm going to face my fears this time.

400900421.text: It's okay, no rush. I came here for my own reasons anyway.

400900422.text: I'll try to overcome my fear... and sleepiness.

400900423.text: But, if you do want to partner up, just let me know...

400900601.text: So, made up your mind yet? Do you wanna team up with me?

400900603.text: Hehe, awesome! Don't worry, you'll see that being on my team is a blast!

400900604.text: Now let's get out there and win this thing... We'll move faster than a firework shooting straight into the sky! It'll be like WHOOOSHHH and the round will be ours!

400900607.text: Well anyway, I'll be right here if you change your mind!

400900801.text: Haha, want to team up with me?

400900804.text: I can't guarantee we'll be able to win the second round, but I'll do my best to help. Let's give it our best shot!

400900806.text: Ah, not a problem. I still wish you the best of luck, no matter who you chose to team up with.

400900807.text: Just be sure not to put too much pressure on yourself. The Test of Courage is meant to be a fun event, focusing only on winning would defeat the whole purpose of participating.

400909601.text: Something just fell from above! Ah, keep it away from Paimon!!!

400909602.text: Really? Lemme see... Oh! It's some Onikabuto!

400909604.text: Hey, did you guys hear that?

400909613.text: That's strange... How did Paimon transform into a Lavender Melon?

400909614.text: Hey, Paimon's over here! That doesn't even look like Paimon!

400909615.text: Hmm? So, what in the world is this...? Hey, it's flying away. Don't go! Let me have a look at ya!

400909616.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or is there an eerie shadow over there?

400909617.text: Oh, you're right! That wasn't there when we arrived!

400909618.text: There's clearly no one around, but there's a shadow on the ground. Oh, this is like a real kaidan story!

400909621.text: Phew... This should be far enough.

400909622.text: Are you tired, Paimon? Do you want to take a break?

400909627.text: Hmm? What is this stall doing here? Maybe it's for participants who need a break?

400909628.text: Excuse me! Three glasses of juice, please...

400909629.text: Hehe! Don't worry, this time it's on me!

400909631.text: Uh, excuse me! Anyone here? Strange... seems like no one's around. Guess we'll just have to keep going.

400909632.text: Huh, another stall? It sure looks familiar...

400909633.text: Wait, this is the same stall we saw earlier!

400909634.text: Ah, it's back again! Maybe it's following us. Ah, help!

400909635.text: Wow, look at all the lanterns here! It's so beautiful!

400909636.text: But now that I look closer, it seems like the lanterns are floating in midair. How is that possible?

400909638.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, can I borrow your shoulders for a second? You can give me a boost and I'll pull one of them down!

400909640.text: You want to explore somewhere else? Uh, how about we finish the Test of Courage first!

400909641.text: C'mon, let's go. We can't let anyone beat us to it!

400909704.text: I can hear your teeth chattering, Paimon. You must be really scared.

400909707.text: But I heard a rattling sound... Was that not you?

400909708.text: It's definitely not Paimon! Wait... It seems to be coming from inside the shrine!

400909712.text: It's so dark here. It's hard to make out anything.

400909713.text: It's so dim that Paimon almost looks like a flying Lavender Melon...

400909714.text: Hey, that's not Paimon! It doesn't look anything like me!

400909716.text: Ah! It's a... Lavender Melon ghost!

400909717.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or is there an eerie shadow over there?

400909723.text: I usually like to hide here and take a nap...

400909724.text: Don't worry. There doesn't appear to be anything scary here.

400909731.text: We've been running for so long that Paimon's starting to get thirsty.

400909732.text: Oh look, there's a stall set up. Let's go buy something to drink.

400909734.text: Hello? Anyone here? Strange, there's nobody around.

400909735.text: Oh, I dunno... This stall looks kinda spooky.

400909736.text: Waaaah! You're right, it's starting to creep Paimon out! Let's just get outta here!

400909737.text: Huh, another stall? It sure looks familiar...

400909738.text: Wait, this is the same stall we saw earlier!

400909739.text: Ah, it's back again! Maybe it's following us. Ah, help!

400909837.text: Huh, another stall? It sure looks familiar...

400909838.text: Wait, this is the same stall we saw earlier!

400909839.text: Ah, it's b—b—back again! Maybe it's following us!

400909840.text: I'm not sure whose stall this is, but pestering people to buy your stuff is definitely a poor business practice...

400909841.text: Good thing these lanterns are here, they sure make the path a lot brighter.

400909842.text: You think so? Paimon thinks they look a little spooky...

400909843.text: Haha, I don't think there's any reason to worry.

400909844.text: Despite what the lanterns look like, whoever placed them here probably didn't mean any harm.

400909845.text: Believe me, there's plenty of other options if they intended to cause us harm. Alright, let's continue, shall we?

400909847.text: I'm feeling a little worn out myself, let's stop and take a break for a while.

400909901.text: Well, the second round of the Test of Courage is about to begin.

400909902.text: Hmm, Paimon wonders if the shrine maiden knows anything about what Heizou told us... Let's go ask her.

400909904.text: Ah, just run! Don't worry about me!

400909905.text: Hah! Don't underestimate this oni! None of you are getting away today!

400909906.text: Hey, it's Itto! It looks like he captured those three we were looking for!

400909911.text: You get separated from your partner during the Test of Courage
